notes.title: Improved "Add stroke tool"! UV overlap measures!
notes.content:
Update Ver0.9.4 Jun/07/2020

For me, Artstage has already all the necessary features for modeling, so I started modeling in earnest myself using Artstage.

I noticed it only after actually using it, but the stroke addition tool is more convenient than expected.
The shape of the stroke can be set in detail, and the width of the stroke can be changed by the depth of pulling the trigger.
The great thing is that you can edit the mesh of your strokes after you create them. You can adjust the shape of the entire stroke with proportional editing, or move individual vertices.
For example, you can easily and quickly create a character's hair with a triangular stroke.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26156642/7acfcdd518e589f4db98cf7506392bf72ec68f66.jpg[/img]

This is a video that actually creates hair using the stroke addition tool and adjusts the shape by proportional editing.
Watch video in this tweet!
https://twitter.com/_darger/status/1268171220156944384

Two options have been added to make Add stroke tool more convenient to use.
The first is the "Cross rotation" option. For example, when making hair, it is easier to work by rotating the cross section 180 degrees.

The second option is "Create stroke as new object". Up to now, objects were created for each stroke by default, but it will be inconvenient to work if there are too many objects. If this option is unchecked, strokes will be added to the current object. Again, you can easily select individual strokes using the linked mesh selection shortcut.

Also, the default quality UV unwrapping may previously generate overlapping UVs, but we have taken steps to fix this. By default quality, UV unwrapping of sufficiently high quality is now done.

What's more, sketch strokes are now displayed much cleaner.
Added "Size with pressure" option to Sketch Strokes tool. When the check is turned on, the stroke width can be changed depending on the depth of pulling the trigger.


Features
-A "Cross rotation" option has been added to the Add Stroke tool. For example, when making hair, it is easier to work by rotating the cross section 180 degrees.
-Added "Create stroke as new object" option to Add Stroke tool. Up to now, objects were created for each stroke by default, but it will be inconvenient to work if there are too many objects. If this option is unchecked, strokes will be added to the current object. Again, you can easily select individual strokes using the linked mesh selection shortcut.
-Added "Size with Pressure" option to Sketch Stroke Tool. When the check is turned on, the stroke width can be changed depending on the depth of pulling the trigger.

Improvement
-Sketch strokes are displayed cleaner than ever.
-Added UV overlap protection to default quality UV unwrap.

Fixes
-Sketch data is not saved when the model is saved with the sketch hidden.
-Problem with "Pin at X zero" option
-UV unwrapping fails after adding strokes with Add Stroke Tool.
-The uvScale value is not saved when the model is saved.

note: Features of early access are not stable. These may be changed or abolished.

notes.title: Implemented movement and extrusion in the normal direction!
notes.content:
Update Ver0.9.3 May/27/2020

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26156642/b1b859a8dbe0a12dc2661c3a2bf7a097514dbad7.jpg[/img]

Watch video in this tweet!
https://twitter.com/_darger/status/1265659110462111745

Added "Treat scaling operation as normal direction moves" option to the config of move / extrude tool. With the check box selected, pull the trigger and tilt the thumbstick left or right to move or extrude in the normal direction.

Added options for model open, import and export. You can scale the model, invert the specified axis direction, rotate, move to the center(Only when opening or importing).
When importing or exporting a model from Blender, it was displayed as inverted in the X direction, but it can be corrected with this options.

We have found that the best quality UV unwraping does not work properly when the model contains polygons that not triangle and not  flat. This feature depends on third party libraries and is difficult to fix. A warning message is now displayed when performing the best quality UV unwraping. Instead, we have improved the quality of packing when UV unwraping with default quality.
So now you can basically use the default quality UV unwraping without any problems. If you are having problems with the default quality, you may also try to triangulate the model polygons and try the best quality UV unwraping.


Features
-Added "Treat scaling operation as normal direction moves" option to the config of move / extrude tool. With the check box selected, pull the trigger and tilt the thumbstick left or right to move or extrude in the normal direction.
-Added options for model open, import and export. You can scale the model, invert the specified axis direction, rotate, move to the center(Only when opening or importing).

Improvement
-Option settings for menu items are saved when the app is closed and loaded at the next launch.

Changes
-We have found that the best quality UV unwraping does not work properly when the model contains polygons that not triangle and not  flat. This feature depends on third party libraries and is difficult to fix. A warning message is now displayed when performing the best quality UV unwraping. Instead, we have improved the quality of packing when UV unwraping with default quality.
So now you can basically use the default quality UV unwraping without any problems. If you are having problems with the default quality, you may also try to triangulate the model polygons and try the best quality UV unwraping.

Fixes
-Sketch stroke display issue.
-All selections may be canceled unintentionally.
-Pressing the Oculus Touch menu button resets the controller display.
-Error may occur when loading obj file.
-Cannot enter folder name when creating new folder in File Explorer.
-Turning smooth shading on makes it difficult to paint texture.

note: Features of early access are not stable. These may be changed or abolished.

notes.title: Access Google Poly Library!
notes.content:
Update Ver0.9.0 Nov/23/2019

You can now search for models uploaded to Google Poly from within the app and import them directly as edit models or reference objects!
You can easily use a huge variety of models in your works. Please note that all models have a Creative Commons license and need attribution when used in their your works.
"Blocks" type models are ideal for editing in Artstage. For other types of models, textures are not imported. Also, a model with too many vertices may not be edited comfortably. In particular, the “Tilt Brush” type model has low reproducibility and may not be suitable for editing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26156642/acd60892725f881c8dae410e1ee9d893cc0f7050.jpg[/img]

Watch video in this tweet!
https://twitter.com/_darger/status/1198155146628235264

The Insert Edge Loop Tool, which was often requested, has been implemented. You can insert an edge loop anywhere on the edge.

The "Delete Faces" action has been changed to the "Delete Elements" action. If the selection mode is vertex or edge, the selected vertices and edges are deleted respectively.
For example, you can delete an edge loop by selecting an edge loop and executing the "Delete Elements" action.

Added "Duplicate faces" action.

"Scaling" action was added. You can scale selected vertices. If a negative value is entered for the magnification, mirroring can be performed for any axis.

Added "Clear UV" action. You can reset the UV value of the selected vertex to (0,0).

When opening a model, you can now select from a list of recently opened files.

Features
-Added "Poly Library" item to Other Menu. You can search for models uploaded to Google Poly from the app and import them directly as edit models or reference objects.
-Added "Duplicate Face" action. #64
-Added "Scaling" action. You can scale selected vertices. If a negative value is entered for the magnification, mirroring can be performed for any axis. #64 #18
-Added "Insert Edge Loop" tool. You can insert an edge loop anywhere on the edge. #59 #41
-Added "Clear UV" action. You can reset the UV value of the selected vertex to (0,0).
-"Delete Faces" action has been changed to "Delete Elements" action. If the selection mode is vertex or edge, the selected vertex and edge are deleted respectively. #62
-When opening a model, you can now select from a list of recently opened files.

Fixes
-When using an image sketch, some interface elements become invisible if there is an image behind them. #85
-When OpenSubdiv is on, seams are visible along UV seam. #79

Abolished
-The option to "divide every 10,000 polygons" when opening a model has been abolished because it is not useful.

note: Features of early access are not stable. These may be changed or abolished.

notes.title: Added "Sketch image"!
notes.content:
Update Ver0.8.4 Sep/23/2019

"Sketch image" has been added to Artstage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26156642/ccc6c328bfed032be5c500ad367f566085bb62da.jpg[/img]

Watch video in this tweet!
https://twitter.com/_darger/status/1176133952068710400

Sketch image can open any image files. It similar as "Reference image".
It can be used to display the model template for example.
The difference from the reference image is that it follows the movement and scaling of the model. Since sketch images are belong to sketch objects, use the sketch move tool and sketch delete tool to move and delete them.
The reference image(file path) is saved in the app preferences file, but the sketch image is saved in the model file (.asm).

Significantly improved the internal structure of the application to eliminate potential bugs due to multithreading contention.
Improved application stability.

Improved parallel processing for improved performance on CPUs with many cores.

When using Rift S, a new Touch controller was displayed and the part of UI display was blocked. To avoid this problem, you can change the display to the old Touch controller by changing the controller type from Default to Rift.
With this update, even when using Rift S, the old Touch controller is automatically displayed.

In addition, the controller can be switched to semi-transparent display from the setting. Since the viewing angle is limited in VR, there is a possibility that stress can be reduced by eliminating objects that block the field of vision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26156642/a03b16e8564709b619322fd6ce4a7f6495e3eff7.jpg[/img]

You can now rename objects and texture layers.

And many bug fixes are included.

Features
-"Sketch image" function has been added. Added "Open Sketch Image" button to the reference menu.
-You can now rename objects and texture layers.  "Rename" button has been added to the object menu and layer menu.
-Edges on the space added by "Add vertices tool" can be deleted at once. Added “Delete all edges in space, not included in faces” button to object menu.
-It is now possible to turn on / off the display of the SteamVR play area boundary from Preferences.
-"Controller material" section has been added to Preferences, allowing you to select transparent display of controller.

Improvements
-Speed up "Weld Vertices" action.
-Significantly improved the internal structure of the application to eliminate potential bugs due to multi-threading contention.
-Improved parallel processing for improved performance on CPUs with many cores

Fixes
-"Create Face Tool" sometimes creates faces in the wrong direction
-Stains may occur during texture painting
-It may be difficult sometimes to paint meshes that are complicated when texture painting.
-Some corners of faces may not be painted during texture painting.
-Vertex paint and texture paint may have different palette colors and actual paint colors.
-Images displayed on the virtual desktop are dark.
-Edge highlighted may not be normal in the "Create face tool".
-Edge thickness value set by "Scale of thickness of edge display" is not reflected when the application is started.

notes.title: Added "Add Vertices Tool"!
notes.content:
Update Ver0.8.3 Aug/13/2019

Added "Add Vertices Tool" to Artstage!

Watch video in this tweet!
https://twitter.com/_darger/status/1160929762950279168

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26156642/c928b30ba171ff139cdea1a1150a90628dfe937b.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26156642/d62e81db2330bb6b8df6b183934ea4a853a961cc.jpg[/img]

You can add vertices to any point in space.

You can consider modeling the model without being limited by face constraints.

Also, the edge display has become thicker, and the thickness can be changed from preferences. Until now, it was displayed with a fixed thickness of 1 pixel, but there was a problem that it became difficult to see as the HMD became higher resolution.

The thickness of the edges and the size of the vertices change according to the distance, and they are displayed with a natural perspective. This can be turned on and off from preferences.

Mirror side edges are now displayed for mirrored objects.


Added "Triangulate Faces" action. You can divide the selected faces into triangles.

Features
-"Add vertices tool" has been added to tools.
-Added "Triangulate Faces" action to face actions.
-The vertex display and edge display scale can be change in preferences.
-For vertex display and edge display, the option to scale according to the distance can be turned on / off in preferences.

Improvements
-Edge display has become thicker.
-Edges are now displayed on the mirror side of mirrored objects.
-In Move tool, Edges adjacent to the moving vertices  are now highlighted in real time.

Changes
-Regarding the "Merge to below object" function, the below object was merged to the above object so far. but now, the above object merged to the below object. Maybe, that will be more intuitive.

Fixes
-When using the "Merge to below object" function, the smooth weight of the below object clear.
-When an edge extrude on an object that has been "mirror duplicated",  the face is generated in the opposite side.
-Undo of “Unwrap and bake” cannot be performed normally.
-If the floor showing is off when the app starts, it will not be reflected even if it is turned on.

notes.title: Added Direct pointer mode!
notes.content:
Update Ver0.8.2 Jun/28/2019

Added Direct pointer mode to Artstage!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26156642/3efe7a3dcf893079031cf115a040fddf08539833.jpg[/img]

Watch video in this tweet!
https://twitter.com/_darger/status/1144455247286304768

When Direct Pointer mode is enabled, you can paint by touching the model directly with the cursor without pulling a trigger when painting textures.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26156642/be816c678ef9d2416513f17829a3185782bd99c5.jpg[/img]

If the "Size with pressure" option is enabled, the brush size gets bigger as you pierce the cursor deeper into the model.

Also, in direct pointer mode, the UI can be operated with touch without trigger.

By changing the cursor direction to the bottom of the controller, you can paint with the controller holding like the pen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26156642/2e1c6b77f1dbe38773368bc50859304ed7801f15.jpg[/img]

Holding the controller like a pen makes precise paint strokes easy.


Also, it is now possible to hide currently selected faces during texture painting, or to show only currently selected faces.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26156642/a92d7efe21f254f72a223dbae2204b2183cb65f3.jpg[/img]

You can hide faces that you want to mask or hide obstacle while painting.

We also fixed some texture paint issues that were found while implementing this feature.


In addition, an option to manually select the controller operation type has been added.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26156642/1c6f0e08e2858f61861ce30e7323be9a9dacd701.jpg[/img]

Artstage switched the operation method of the controller by identifying the type of HMD, but in the future we realized that there could be a combination of Vive HMD and Index controller, and Index HMD and Vive controller.

The user can manually select the controller type to select the operation type best suited to his environment.

You can select "Oculus Touch" or "Vive" in addition to "Default" which automatically identifies as before. Most VR controllers come with a touch pad or thumb stick, so it should be sufficient to use the Touch or Vive controls.

Users can also fine-tune button placement from the controller binding config of SteamVR.

For example, when playing Artstage from Oculus Quest using ALVR or VRidge, you should be able to perform the same operation as Oculus Rift by setting the controller type to "Touch".


Features
-Added direct pointer mode. It is enabled by turning on "Enable direct pointer mode" in Preferences.
-Added "Hide pointer ray in direct pointer mode" option to Preferences.
-It is now possible to hide the currently selected face or hide all but the currently selected face when painting textures. You can select from the tool config of the texture paint tool. You can use it to hide obstructed faces while painting or to mask faces that you do not want to paint.
-You can now manually select the controller type from Preferences. In the case of "Default", HMD is automatically detected as before. If it is "Oculus Touch" or "Vive", it will switch to each operation type forcibly. The controllers displayed on VR is also show as selected.
-You can now choose whether the eyedropper gets an alpha value in the tool config of the texture paint tool.

Improvements
-When painting textures, you can no longer paint on the reverse side.
-When painting textures, you can paint without hitting pointer ray to the model. (Normal pointer paint only) Makes it easier to fill the corner of the face.

Changes
-The eyedropper no longer gets an alpha value by default during texture painting.

Fixes
-The texture paint bleeds when hiding one of the adjacent UV islands.

note: Features of early access are not stable. These may be changed or abolished.

notes.title: Added experimental shortcut function!
notes.content:
Update Ver0.8.1 May/27/2019

Added experimental shortcut function to Artstage!

Watch video in this tweet!
https://twitter.com/_darger/status/1132904540867420160

Since the VR can not access the keyboard, the challenge was how to access each function as quickly as a keyboard shortcut.

With the new shortcut feature, you can quickly access various features simply by pressing the touch pad twice (in the case of the Oculus Touch, tilt the stick twice).

This is an experimental feature, but if you like it, you may be able to assign any feature where you like in the future.
 
In addition, it is possible to cancel the vertices added while using the Knife tool and the Create face tool with the undo button.

Features
-Added experimental shortcut function.

Improvements
-You can now cancel the last cut you added with the undo button while using the Knife tool.
-You can now cancel the last added vertex with the undo button while using the Create face tool.
-When scaling the model by pressing the grips of both hands, the midpoint between both hands is now scaled to the origin. In other words, it became more intuitive.

Changes
-Textures are now initialized when creating a new model.

Fixes
-Reduce the occurrence of problems that the knife tool is not partially executed.
-The selected tool becomes a move tool when saved a model.
-Edge loop can not be selected with Oculus Touch.

notes.title: An update that renews everything!
notes.content:
An update that renews everything!
[b]Artstage has been reborn as a full-scale VR modeling application![/b]
A newly reborn icon-based viewable and functional user interface.
The texture painting feature integrated into modeling has been renewed from CPU processing to GPU processing and it has been made much faster.
Implemented vertex color paint feature! You can seamlessly transition to texture paint by baking the vertex color to the texture.
Supported Artstage's native file format (.asm). This allows you to save and open a model's n-gon while holding it.
Also, models can now be exported in fbx format.
The snap function, handle function, constraint function greatly improved modeling operability.
The tutorial video has also become new with the update.
Along with this update, unfortunately the sculpting function and the panorama painting function have been abolished.
Because VR sculpt already has a great application such as Oculus Medium, Artstage will focuses on polygon modeling feature.
Those who need the sculpting function and panoramic painting function can continue to access past version of Artstage.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26156642/8577c668294fb0130c72c6bf84ffec12f9b1e6e1.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26156642/4d23c048ddc485814d8ceeeacaf62c9f57326b30.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26156642/99252936d60a7a17076bddac86a50ddad0038482.jpg[/img]

I created a model using this version.
Watch video in this tweet!
https://twitter.com/_darger/status/1070256131941912576

------------------
Update Ver0.7.0 Dec/16/2018

Features
· The entire UI of the application has been redesigned to a new icon-based one.
· The texture paint was changed from CPU processing to GPU based processing, and it was greatly speeded up.
· The fbx export function was implemented.
· The Move Constraint function has been implemented.
· Grid display function was implemented.
· The Snap function has been implemented.
· The Handle function was implemented.
· Vertex color paint feature was implemented.
· Unwrapping & bake makes it possible to bake vertex color to texture.
· Log display has been implemented.
· It is now possible to save and load files with Artstage's native file format .asm. You can save n-gons without dividing them into triangles.

Changes
· Texture paint was integrated into modeling feature.
· Self beacon movement was abolished. Instead, you can now use your touchpad to rotate, climb, and descent yourself when using the teleport tool.

Abolished
· Sculpt function and panoramic paint function are abolished to focus on modeling feature. Those who need these functions can continue to access Ver0.6.0.

How to access the past version (Ver. 0.6.0)
In the Steam client's library, Artstage item, right click → Properties → Beta tab → Ver 0.6.0 Please select.

note: Features of early access are not stable. These may be changed or abolished.

notes.title: Knife Tool Feature!
notes.content:
We added a knife tool with polygon modeling.
Intuitively add vertices to faces and edges.
We also added Delete vertices tool and Delete edges tool.
You can easily refine unnecessary vertices and edges that made too much with a knife.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26156642/bf34090727a00747c5223d1f150de9608d617d1f.jpg[/img]

About Knife, Watch video in this tweet.
https://twitter.com/_darger/status/882532822841413632

------------------
Update Ver0.6.0 Jul/5/2017

Features
- We added a knife tool in polygon modeling. You can add a knife vertex on a face or edge by bringing the sphere cursor closer to the object and pulling the trigger. Next to the face you can add a knife vertex to the edge of the same face or same face. Next to the edge you can add a knife vertex on the face connected to the same edge or same edge. By pressing the touchpad, knife processing is confirmed. An auxiliary edge may be added so that no holes are opened in faces.Processing the knife tool on too complex faces may be failed.
- Delete vertices tool was added in polygon modeling. If you select the Delete tool and select vertex mode, you can use Delete vertices tool. When you pull a trigger, it deletes the vertex in the cursor. The actual process merges each vertex to the nearest vertex whose vertex is connected by the edge. If this causes a hole in the surface, the polygon at the end of the hole will be deleted so that there is no hole.
- Delete edges tool was added in polygon modeling. If you select the Delete tool and select the edge mode, you can use Delete edges tool. Pulling a trigger deletes the edge in the cursor. notes.title: Special update! Polygon modeling feature!
notes.content:
Polygon modeling feature added to the art stage!
You can enjoy the real modeling feature in VR.
Making a model in VR is very intuitive and fun.
you can make from scratch. and also open and edit obj, fbx file.
Let's draw the texture in paint mode for the finished model!
We're thrilled to be able to deliver this feature to you!

Main feature
- Move vertices and faces directly in object, vertex, face, edge mode.
- Create multiple objects and manage them in the object panel.
- Intuitive creation, movement, rotation, scaling of the selection.
- Undo, redo correspondence.
- Correspond to mirror display and freezing of mirror display .
- Create surfaces by hitting vertices directly in VR space with "Create face tool".
- Extrude faces and edges with "Extrude tool".
- "Add primitive tool" creates various primitives.
- Various commands. Subdivide, Connect, Detach, Collapse, Insert edge loop, etc.
- Supported open file format is obj , fbx.
- Supported export file format is obj.
- You can watch Tutorial videos in application.

Watch video in this tweet.
https://twitter.com/_darger/status/838783226101424128

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26156642/4152b07e72327aa076e38ab056c149d55682e6cd.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26156642/88bb11342ac983faa4335e5ba2e56fcaeb6c85ea.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26156642/c723846805b68cc1478a0cedf5e7a3333a00ab9a.jpg[/img]

------------------

Features
- Polygon modeling feature added.
- Tutorial videos of Polygon modeling section was added.

Improvement
- When moving the model by pressing the grip button of the left hand controller, it gets smoothly interpolated.
- The motion of the pointer of the right hand controller now moves interpolated.

Fixes
- The UI can not be operated unless the application window of Artstage is active.

- Added eyedropper tool in paint mode. You were able to use it in a shortcut in a paint tool, but it is a tool now to do it clearly.
- Added paint tool panel in paint mode. You can select tools paint, eraser, eyedropper, and can use undo/redo.
